annotations.exact_quote: Partial multi-label learning (PML) aims to learn from training examples each associated with a set of candidate labels, among which only a subset are valid for the training example.
annotations.reason_zh: PML面向候选标签集合学习多标记预测，实例可有多个有效标记，属弱监督多标记学习任务。

annotations.exact_quote: After that, a multi-class predictive model is learned by fitting a regularized multi-output regressor with the recovered label distributions.
annotations.reason_zh: 提出的预测模型以恢复的标签分布为拟合目标，对应预测各标签相对描述程度的标签分布学习。

annotations.exact_quote: In this paper, a new partial multi-label learning strategy named Pml-ld is proposed to learn from partial multi-label examples via label enhancement. Specifically, label distributions are recovered by leveraging the topological information of the feature space and the correlations among the labels.
annotations.reason_zh: 明确通过标记增强从部分多标记样本恢复标签分布，属于从较粗标签构建更细标签分布的核心任务。
